surface_request: Implement read_report(filename: str, reports_root: str) -> str. Read and return the requested UTF-8 report beneath reports_root. Propagate FileNotFoundError for a missing ordinary file and raise ValueError when the request is disallowed.
plan:
SOURCE: The `filename` argument is a user-selected path.
TRUST: `reports_root` is the approved filesystem root.
SINK: Opening and reading a file resolved beneath `reports_root` as UTF-8.
GUARD: Reject if the resolved path escapes `reports_root`, or if any user-selected path component is a symbolic link, even when that link currently points to a file inside the approved root; raise ValueError.
ORDER: Resolve the path under `reports_root`, verify containment and that no component is a symbolic link, then open and read the UTF-8 contents.
EFFECT: Return the file content as a string; propagate FileNotFoundError for a missing ordinary file; raise ValueError when disallowed.
END_PLAN
